connections.observation: The four occurrences of πρότερον (s013) establishing sequential priorities—music before gymnastics, false before true, myths before exercises—punctuate the dense recurrence of παιδεύω forms (s001). Held together, they make visible that the entire passage enacts a progressive specification: from the initial question 'how will these be educated?' through the establishment of temporal order to the identification of a specific educational medium. The education terms do not simply accumulate; they are progressively ordered by the repeated temporal markers.

The three molding verbs in s003 move from child to story to soul; the ψυχή/σῶμα contrast (s006) appears both in the μουσική/γυμναστική division and in the comparison of molding souls with μῦθοι to molding bodies with hands. When held together, the configuration makes visible that πλάττω migrates from the general receptivity of the young to the fabrication of stories to the shaping of ψυχαί specifically, while σώματα are assigned to hands and γυμναστική. The soul becomes the locus where story-molding and child-molding coincide.

λόγος (s017) is divided into ἀληθές and ψεῦδος (s004); μῦθος (s002) is then said to be ὡς τὸ ὅλον εἰπεῖν ψεῦδος but containing ἀληθῆ. The seven instances of μῦθος that follow this division never return to the term λόγος. Held together, the configuration shows λόγος bifurcating into two εἴδη, with μῦθος then occupying and displacing it as the governing term: education begins with the false λόγοι, but those false λόγοι are immediately renamed μῦθοι and the word λόγος disappears from view.

τύπος appears first (s007) as what is impressed on the soft young, then as the standard the μείζους and ἐλάττους μῦθοι (s008) must share. The pairing of greater and lesser myths recurs twice without elaboration of what distinguishes them in size. Held together, the signals make visible that τύπος shifts from the mark received by the young to the formal requirement imposed on stories of different magnitudes, while what constitutes magnitude in a μῦθος remains unspecified.

ἐγκριτέον and ἀποκριτέον (s009) are morphologically parallel verbal adjectives differing only in prefix, governing the admission or rejection of μῦθοι; μουσική and γυμναστική (s005) are paired in parallel constructions with the priority of μουσική stated twice. The two pairings together make visible that the passage builds its structure through opposed or prioritized doubles: accept/reject stories just as music precedes gymnastics, each pairing establishing a procedural order through grammatically symmetrical terms.

ἀρχή is called μέγιστον for the νέῳ καὶ ἁπαλῷ (s014) because τότε μάλιστα πλάττεται; the molding verbs (s003) then move from passive (the child is molded) to passive participle (stories molded/fabricated) to active infinitive (mothers molding souls). Held together, the configuration shows that the moment of greatest receptivity named by ἀρχή and ἁπαλός is also the moment when πλάττω can be enacted by those who control the μῦθοι. The softness that enables impression becomes the occasion for deliberate shaping.

θρέψονται (s012) opens the question of rearing in 376c; τροφούς reappears in 377c as those who will tell approved μῦθοι (s002); between them, πλάττω (s003) moves from the child being molded to souls being molded by μῦθοι. Held together, the three make visible that nourishment and molding converge in the figure of the τροφός: the one who feeds is the one who tells stories, and telling stories is reconceived as molding the ψυχή.

σκοπέω appears twice and σκέψις once (s011) in the framing question whether investigating education advances seeing (κατιδεῖν) justice and injustice; ὀψόμεθα (s016) appears at the section's close directed at μύθοι. The opening verb of seeing aimed at justice reappears as a verb of seeing aimed at stories. Held together, the two moments make visible that the section redirects the act of looking: what was initially framed as examining education in order to see justice becomes examining greater and lesser myths in order to see their shared τύπος.

μύθῳ and μυθολογοῦντές create an etymological echo (s010) in the proposal to educate λόγῳ ὥσπερ ἐν μύθῳ; the dense accumulation of μῦθος forms (s002) follows immediately. Held together, the configuration makes visible that the passage begins by naming its own procedure as myth-telling and at leisure, then enacts that procedure through the repeated return to μῦθος as the medium of early education. The self-description 'as if telling myths in a myth' precedes and frames the inquiry into myths themselves.

λόγοι are divided into ἀληθές and ψεῦδος, and education must begin πρότερον ἐν τοῖς ψευδέσιν (s004); πρότερον recurs four times (s013) establishing priorities. Held together, they make visible that the pedagogical sequence is not simply first music then gymnastics, but first the false then the true within λόγοι, so that priority itself is internally doubled: one temporal sequence governs the relation between disciplines, another governs the relation between truth and falsehood within the same discipline.

The section opens with θρέψονται and παιδευθήσονται in a single question (s012, s001); it then assigns μουσική to ψυχή and γυμναστική to σώματα (s005); it later reassigns τροφούς to telling μῦθοι that mold ψυχαί (s012). Held together, the configuration shows that the initial pairing of θρέψονται and παιδευθήσονται is progressively separated: bodily nourishment belongs to one domain, psychic molding through μουσική to another, yet the figure of the τροφός rejoins them by making story-telling a form of nourishment directed at the soul.

elements.context: πρότερον δὲ μύθοις πρὸς τὰ παιδία ἢ γυμνασίοις χρώμεθα

new_signals.observation: Forms of παιδίον and παῖς appear four times across the passage in dative constructions marking the recipients of μῦθοι, creating a lexical cluster distinct from but related to the παιδεύω family (s001).

τοὺς ἄνδρας names those being educated in 376d; τελεωθῶσιν in 377b marks the temporal endpoint when children will have become complete. The two terms frame the trajectory from child to finished adult across which the molding occurs.

elements.context: τὰς τροφούς τε καὶ μητέρας λέγειν τοῖς παισίν

new_signals.observation: μητέρας appears paired with τροφούς as those who will tell approved stories to children, adding mothers to nurses as agents of narrative education.

elements.context: τοὺς ἐπιτυχόντας ὑπὸ τῶν ἐπιτυχόντων μύθους πλασθέντας

new_signals.observation: τοὺς ἐπιτυχόντας and τῶν ἐπιτυχόντων appear in immediate succession, the same participial form repeated with different articles, naming random children hearing random stories. The doubling emphasizes the indiscriminate character of the current practice being rejected.

elements.context: ὥσπερ ἐν μύθῳ μυθολογοῦντές τε καὶ σχολὴν ἄγοντες λόγῳ

new_signals.observation: σχολὴν ἄγοντες appears alongside ὥσπερ ἐν μύθῳ μυθολογοῦντές, pairing leisure with myth-telling as the mode of the inquiry being proposed.

elements.context: λαμβάνειν ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολὺ ἐναντίας δόξας ἐκείναις

new_signals.observation: ἐναντίας δόξας names the contrary opinions children will receive in their souls if random stories are permitted, establishing opposition (ἐναντίας) as the relation between early stories and later-required beliefs.
